# Sarnia HVAC Pros

> From its base in Sarnia, Lambton County, Sarnia HVAC Pros serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 337-2184  |  Email: contact@sarniahvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://sarniahvacpros.ca

Service areas: Sarnia, Point Edward, Corunna, Petrolia, Forest, Wyoming
